prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1388; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.
Q: That works. Can you tell me where you were when the accident happened?
A: I was on the main road in Baytown, heading east, in the right lane. I was trying to move over into the middle lane because I needed to get to the exit.
Q: What time of day was it, and what were the road conditions?
A: It was late afternoon. It was dry, and traffic was moderate, not stopped or anything.
Q: Walk me through what happened when you changed lanes.
A: I checked my mirror and saw a gap. I put on my signal, started to move over, and then I felt a jolt on my side. The other car had come up in the middle lane and clipped the side of my vehicle. Their side mirror hit my door and the rear quarter panel.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?
A: Not really. I looked in the mirror, but it must have been in my blind spot.
Q: Did you stop after the impact, and did you exchange information with the other driver?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder right away. We exchanged insurance and contact details, and we took photos of both cars.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches, mostly when I sit for a long time or get up from the couch. I went to urgent care and they diagnosed me with a neck and back strain. I'm taking anti-inflammatories and doing some stretches.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: No, nothing serious. I've had occasional stiffness from sitting at a desk, but nothing that required treatment.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm willing to provide the photos and the urgent care records if you need them.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
